description:
The Vitus Sentier VRW mountain bike has all the playful confidence of a hardtail that has quickly become a classic, and utilises a women-specific geometry to optimise comfort and control. Rightly this bike has amassed something of a cult following thanks to its entertaining character, but it’s not just the people’s champion.

The Sentier is a multi-award winner that continues to prove itself out there on rough trails and exciting adventures. A hardtail that won’t shy away from technical descents and aggressive riding, it never fails to find that flow and excite. Snappy, obedient and nimble, like a hardtail should be, yet also hungry to go all-in where things get steep and challenging. Where other hardtails get weak at the knees.

Let’s be clear. The Sentier is not just some cheeky upstart or pretender. Far from it. From head to toe, this bike boasts reliable components to keep maintenance low and deliver the finest trail riding experience. The real deal. The longer, slacker geometry gives you the control and stability to cruise the tricky sections, while the shorter stem keeps the handling precise should you need to whip it through the turns. From the dropper post to the 1x10 speed Deore drivetrain and the 130mm X-Fusion fork, this mountain bike is ready for full-on, fun-filled days. The double-butted aluminium frame and quality components are ready to go straight from the box, but as you get to know your Sentier, as you become addicted to it’s personality, so this becomes the perfect chassis to put your own stamp on. To personalise and customise your perfect hardtail setup.

For full-day sessions with mates. For cruising the climbs and railing the descents. For balance and poise with no loss of entertainment. For keeping the fun-factor turned right up. Any time on-board the Sentier is playtime.

Modern frame geometry for aggressive hardtail riding

Marzocchi Bomber Z2 forks

Shimano Deore 1x11 speed drivetrain

Shimano Deore or Clarks M4 hydraulic disc brakes

WTB ST i30 tubeless ready rims with tape applied

Schwalbe Magic Mary & Hans Dampf tyres
